notes.title: English and Chinese Release!
notes.notes:
Hello, I am the author of Atopes (formerly known as Atopes).

I am pleased to inform you of a major update.

Today, November 11, 2022, we have released the English and Simplified Chinese versions of Atopes!
We hope that those of you who have not been able to play the game so far will enjoy it.

We have also released the collection of materials used in the game as DLC.
This is for those who are interested in development.


So, enjoy the game!
